propositions: During a single outbound reconcile pass, config.effective_* helpers invoke filesystem discovery and three-layer overlay resolution once per ticket instead of once per distinct project, causing O(N) redundant calls where N is ticket count and M is project count (M < N)

The _effective_*_for helpers and their delegated config.effective_* methods perform identical computations for the same (project_key, root) pair within a single pass, representing a performance-only issue with no correctness impact

A pass-scoped memoization dict keyed on (axis, project_key) will reduce config discovery calls from O(N) to O(M) within each reconcile pass without changing observable output or introducing process-global state
The memoization implementation via _memoize_effective and optional cache kwargs must maintain zero McCabe complexity increase and keep outbound_differ.py under 800 LOC
Per-project config overlays from [mapping.projects.<KEY>] must be correctly preserved and applied after memoization, verified by output mutations matching pre-memoization behavior
The cache is disabled by default (None) to preserve existing API contracts and test compatibility, enabled only when explicitly threaded through compute_outbound_mutations
